newsitem.title: USA: TRO Learning signs BC TEL courseware pact.
newsitem.headline: TRO Learning signs BC TEL courseware pact.

text.p: TRO Learning Inc said Monday it signed an exclusive agreement to distribute a middle and high school curriculum called Plato via the Internet.

TRO said the contract with a division of BC Telecom Inc, the Canadian telephone service provider, will bring Plato interactive courseware to 170,000 students in British Columbia as part of computer-based learning network.
The partners said Plato courses should be available in 50 percent of the province's public schools by 1998.
Financial terms of the agreement were not announced.
TRO Learning shares closed up 1/2 Monday at 8-1/4.
